violations.why: ISR can reset var1 to 0 between main's init write and its read in func_3, so the read sees a value main did not write.
The ISR write can land between the check var1>=12 and the write of 12, so the check is stale.
The ISR write can land between the check and the else-branch write, so the check is stale.
The ISR can overwrite the 12 that main stored before func_4 reads var1.
The ISR write can land between main's write of 0 and the later read in func_4; the value is the same here, but the write-write-read shape still occurs.
The ISR can change var1 between the two reads, so line 39 can see a different value than line 63 did.
